tiktok-shop-vn.label: TikTok Shop Vietnam
tiktok-shop-vn.reason: TikTok Shop Vietnam states that livestreams must be real-time and that pre-recorded livestreams/videos are reproduced or unoriginal content.
tiktok-shop-vn.reference: TikTok Shop Academy / Non-Interactive Content & Unoriginal Content (checked 2026-08-25)

youtube.label: YouTube Live
youtube.reason: Replay broadcasting is only enabled when the broadcaster confirms all necessary content/music rights and clearly discloses that the source is pre-recorded. YouTube may restrict repetitive/inauthentic content and scans live streams for copyrighted third-party material.
youtube.reference: YouTube Help / Live streaming, Copyright, Channel monetization policies (checked 2026-08-25)

custom-rtmp.label: Custom RTMP
custom-rtmp.reason: MMON Studio cannot infer the destination platform rules. Replay starts only after you confirm that the destination permits pre-recorded broadcasting.
custom-rtmp.reference: Destination platform policy must be checked by the broadcaster
